# Krunal Badami
> Senior Software Engineer | Web, Mobile, and TV | React.js, Next.js, React Native, Roku

Krunal Badami is a senior software engineer with 8+ years on web, mobile, and TV. He builds React.js and Next.js websites, React Native apps, and TV apps on Roku, Apple TV, Android TV, and Fire TV. He writes and reviews the code himself, and uses AI tools when they save time.

Open to senior software engineer and tech lead roles. Based in Mumbai, India. Open to remote work.

## Current work
- Mobile Tech Lead at FatakPay Digital Pvt Ltd (March 2026 to present).
- Leads a team of 10 on a new React Native app: lending, UPI (Mindgate), and mobile security.
- FatakPay company figures: 3 crore downloads and about 25 lakh monthly active users (MAU).
- Store releases: Google Play, Apple App Store, Indus, Xiaomi, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung Galaxy Store, and Amazon Appstore.

## Earlier work
- Senior Software Engineer at Logicwind Technologies LLP and Cappital, LLC (Irvine, CA), August 2020 to February 2026.
- Products include The Daily Wire, PragerU, THINQ Media, Big Time Rush, 28, SimpleCar, AppsOnAir, Stand Firm, Washington Defender, FlickPost, Every Man Ministries, and Pocket Testament League.
- Released 7 React Native libraries on npm, about 20,000 downloads a week.

## Skills
- Web: React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, HTML, CSS, GraphQL, REST.
- Mobile: React Native, Hermes, Metro, iOS, Android.
- TV: Roku, BrightScript, SceneGraph, Apple TV, Android TV, Fire TV, HLS, DASH, Widevine, PlayReady.
- Fintech: UPI, UPI Lite, Autopay, UDIR, lending, credit cards.
